_about: Resume + LinkedIn eval set (QUALITY_GATE.md, claude-cookbooks building_evals). Every person, employer and resume here is SYNTHETIC: made up for testing, not a real person. Each case is a hard request a buyer could make. 'gold' is the delivery we would send; 'bad' is what a careless seller would send, and must fail on 'bad_breaks'. Each case has a 'kind' (Anthropic prompting playbook, rahultechx X-batch 2026-11-23): 'control' = an ordinary request that must always pass, so a rule change that breaks normal work shows up; 'edge' = a case a careless seller gets wrong; 'refuse' = a request we decline in part and say why. Checked by ../../eval_coverage.py.
